Name: Thick Bread
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]I don't know about you but where I come from the standard bread is not a scrawny baguette.

[/i][b]What It Does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changes the sprite of bread object
[*]Changes the description to match (includes English and Japanese)
[/list]
[i]If you encounter any issues or want to add a localization let me know in the comments![/i]

[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.

Manifest.Name: Thick Bread
Manifest.Description: Changes the baguette into a nice thick loaf.
